description: 1 s linear chirp 100->4000 Hz (amp 0.5) + white noise (std 0.05, numpy default_rng seed 0), 16 kHz

conventions.stft_frames: frame t = sqrt_hann * input_wav[t*160 : t*160+320] -> rfft (center=False, no padding)
conventions.model_out_frames: model run on stft_frames[0..7] in order, state starting at zeros
conventions.output_wav: streaming loop: 160-sample history and 160-sample OLA tail start at zeros; for each 160-sample hop: frame=[history, hop] -> STFT -> model -> iSTFT*window -> out = tail + frame[:160], tail = frame[160:]. One output hop per input hop (len == len(input_wav)); output is delayed by 160 samples relative to the input.
conventions.atten_case: same input and conventions, with atten_lim_db = 12 fed on every frame
